[[File:SynBlue-infected.jpg|thumb|[[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]] infected with [[Vongspawn]] virus]]
'''Vongspawn virus''' was the infection [[Shaping protocol|created]] by [[Zenoc Quah]], a fanatical [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|Shaper]], and [[Darth Maladi]], a master of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and high ranking member of the [[One Sith]], that spread out on many terraformed worlds as a result of the sabotaged [[Ossus Project]]. The virus caused painful bony growths to sprout from the skin. It didn't affect any Yuuzhan Vong or the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] - which made it look like they had organized it. The growing tension eventually led to the start of [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the shift of power in galactic society due to the fall of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the rise of the [[Fel Empire]] to dominance, albeit a short-lived one. Many infected [[Vongspawn]]s were left across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as the result of the plague.
